visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a smartphone in a brightly lit modern living room. In the background, a tabby cat is lying on the wooden floor near a child's wooden climbing frame and a mini trampoline. (2) The camera pans down to the tabby cat as it reacts to the phone, looking up with wide, alert eyes and tilted head. (3) The camera moves to show a white-spotted cat sitting on a low white cabinet next to a baby gate and various colorful plastic toys. (4) The camera shifts to an orange cat resting on a miniature beige sofa in a cozy corner near a bookshelf and a rocking horse. (5) The camera returns to the tabby cat and then the white-spotted cat, both showing intense focus and slightly flattened ears while looking at the phone. (6) The camera zooms in on two cats—one tabby and one white-spotted—peeking out from under wooden dining chairs, staring directly into the lens with fixed gazes.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 male character holding the smartphone is partially visible through his hand.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Only the hand of the male creator is visible, holding a black smartphone with a protective case.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A domestic living room with wooden floors, a large TV screen, a child's wooden climbing arch, a mini trampoline, a white baby gate, bookshelves, and various toys scattered around.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks in casual Mandarin with a calm tone and moderate pace. The background contains a faint indoor room tone with no music. (2) A sharp, high-pitched, rhythmic sound effect starts, featuring a fast-tempo vocalization that sounds like a human chanting 'meow' repeatedly in a distorted, meme-like fashion. (3) Brief male laughter is heard, exhibiting high arousal and positive valence, overlapping with the persistent high-pitched chant. (4) The male voice speaks a short sentence before the distorted 'cat curse' vocal sound effect resumes at a consistent volume and high pitch level until the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Repeated Demonstration -> Reaction montage.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate the reaction of multiple domestic cats to a specific 'cat curse' viral sound effect played from a smartphone, highlighting their confused and alert behaviors for entertainment.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video relies heavily on the auditory 'cat curse' sound effect to drive the visual reactions of the animals, creating a comedic effect through the contrast of a domestic setting and the cats' intense focus.
